handler.name: ActorType50_51_PlayerCollisionHandler
handler.semantics: After the terrain-response and actor-collision-flag gates, accepts actor Y - WORLD_CAMERA_Y + 0x20 when it is within 10 pixels of PLAYER_Y, copies actor X - WORLD_CAMERA_X to PLAYER_X, arms PLAYER_INTERACTION_TRANSITION_LOCK and PLAYER_TRANSITION_GATE, and selects CAMERA_HORIZONTAL_THRESHOLD=0x00A0. Runtime type 0x50 promotes to type 0x51 with animation 0x00124BA6 and clears the actor animation timer.

boundary_checks.result: The 130-byte body terminates at RTS immediately before the existing 0x001AF978 handhold handler; no promoted range overlaps.

reachability_qualification: This is a real actor-relative player placement and transition handler. Existing static producer analysis assigns the type-0x50 spawn path to level-table entry 9 rather than the retained Level 01 route, so static presence and exact behavior do not establish live Level 01 reachability.
conclusion: The shared type-0x50/0x51 handler is now canonicalized with its local-coordinate placement formula, transition latches, camera threshold, type promotion, animation root, and exact dispatch boundary.
